prompts.prompt: Find an everyday object with a clear circular shape.
prompts.safetyNote: Photograph only safe objects in a shared area. Do not photograph people, private documents, screens, addresses, credentials, or anything unsafe.
prompts.judgingGuidance: The judge checks the submitted photo against the visible prompt. Accept if it clearly matches; otherwise reject. No automatic image recognition is used.
prompts.hint: Look for the outline of an object; the circular shape should be easy to see in the photo.
